name: io.github.proprock/jira-mini-mcp
title: jira-mini-mcp
description: Minimal Jira Cloud MCP server: broad reads, a narrow 3-tool write surface, optional read-only mode.

environmentVariables.name: JIRA_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Your Jira Cloud site, e.g. https://example.atlassian.net

environmentVariables.name: JIRA_AUTH_METHOD
environmentVariables.description: api_token (default) or oauth; oauth needs an OAuth 2.0 (3LO) app and a one-time `jira-mini-mcp login`

environmentVariables.name: JIRA_EMAIL
environmentVariables.description: The email your Jira API token belongs to (JIRA_AUTH_METHOD=api_token)

environmentVariables.name: JIRA_OAUTH_CLIENT_ID
environmentVariables.description: Client ID of your OAuth 2.0 (3LO) app (JIRA_AUTH_METHOD=oauth)

environmentVariables.name: READ_ONLY_MODE
environmentVariables.description: Set to true, 1, or on to register only the six read tools and withhold the three write tools

environmentVariables.name: STRUCTURED_OUTPUT
environmentVariables.description: Set to true, 1, or on to also send structuredContent and an outputSchema; by default each result is sent once, in content

environmentVariables.name: DISABLE_STRUCTURED_OUTPUT
environmentVariables.description: With STRUCTURED_OUTPUT=true, comma-separated tool names that still return content only, without structuredContent
